question.problem:
$$
f(x)∼\frac{{a}_{0}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{5}x)+{b}_{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{5}x)
$$

Let $F(x)=3{x}^{2}-4$ for $x\in [-5,5).$ The Fourier series of the $10$-periodic extension $f(x)$ of $F(x)$ is shown above. Find the exact value of ${a}_{0}.$

${a}_{0}=$ {{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
For the Fourier series of a $2L$-periodic function, the constant term is given by

$$
{a}_{0}=\frac{1}{L}{\int }_{-L}^{L}f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

In our case, $L=5$ and $f(x)=3{x}^{2}-4$ for $x\in [-5,5).$ So, substituting into the formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{0} & =\frac{1}{5}{\int }_{-5}^{5}(3{x}^{2}-4)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{5}{[{x}^{3}-4x]}_{-5}^{5} \\  & =\frac{1}{5}(({5}^{3}-4\cdot 5)-((-5)^{3}-4\cdot (-5))) \\  & =\frac{1}{5}(105-(-105)) \\  & =42.\end{aligned}
$$
